{{Quote|I'm a prisoner with two bad limbs who's been starved for weeks. But I know one thing. The Warden's going to pay for the Life Day massacre.|Gyylghrard|<ref name="Kessel: Hell in Space" />}}
The '''Life Day massacre''' occurred during an improvised celebration of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] by the young [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] slaves on the [[Kessel prison|Imperial Correctional Facility]] on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].<ref name="Kessel: Hell in Space" />

The Wookiees planned the secret celebration during their mid-day meal break with help from [[Gyylghrard]], who liaised with the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] overseeing the food storage. Gyylghrard managed to obtain rehydrated [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Ryshcate/Legends|ryshcates]] with candles and [[sparkstick]]s for the event.<ref name="Kessel: Hell in Space" />

After the meal, a [[Gender/Legends|female]] Wookiee began growling the melody of the ''[[A Day to Celebrate|Tree of Life]]'', and the rest soon joined in. The candles were supposed to be lit for a single minute after the song, however the Wookiees simultaneously lit their sparksticks and overloaded their electronic shackles.<ref name="Kessel: Hell in Space" />

A fight ensued where the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] found their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] drained of power. The adult slaves joined the fray and they found themselves overpowering the guards. The insurgents managed to take the fight to the launch bays before the stormtroopers, with recharged blasters, cut them all down with blaster fire. Gyylghrard later learned from [[Moruth Doole]] that it was ordered by the [[Warden/Legends|warden]], [[Dewt Kluskine]] himself.<ref name="Kessel: Hell in Space" />

A few years later, Gyylghrard avenged their deaths when he was appointed as an honor guard of the warden. During a visit from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] accountant, [[Fossco]], Gyylghrard took the opportunity to behead Kluskine with his [[Ceremonial poleaxe]] before being killed by the stormtroopers.<ref name="Kessel: Hell in Space" />
